name: Chat Message
description: A framework-free Web Component for the bubbles in a conversation: text, pictures, quoted replies, voice notes and attachments. Every message names its speaker as a word, because which side a bubble sits on is invisible to a screen reader.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: Text messages both ways, runs worked out from the neighbours, and the speaker said as a word.

variants.name: Image
variants.description: Picture messages, and the box held open at the picture's own shape before it arrives.

variants.name: Reply
variants.description: Quoting a message, shortened honestly and linked back to the original.

variants.name: Voice
variants.description: Voice notes with a real player, and the transcript that makes them readable at all.

variants.name: Attachment
variants.description: Files and links, named and sized so they can be identified before they are opened.

variants.name: States
variants.description: Sending, failed with a retry, edited, deleted, a system notice, and text that cannot break.
